scenario_results.observed: FinanceOperationsIntegrationTest: a pickup order of 24000 completed, cash reported and verified (24000) and commission posted produces no ledger entry of 24000; the commission receivable is 2400; the finance statement shows direction COOK_PAYS_PLATFORM, verified cash 24000 as position only, outstanding commission 2400 and one unsettled entry; customers 403, unknown kitchen 404. Cook statement (CookWorkspaceIntegrationTest) includes REFUNDS and SETTLEMENTS with the same direction.

Refund of 1000 (not full) and 30000 (over) are 422; settlement staff 403; 24000 is REQUESTED; a second request is 409 while the first is committed; payment before approval 409; the requester cannot approve (403); after approval the statement shows APPROVED (unpaid) and no reversal; payment without reference 422; the payer cannot verify (403); verification by another person makes it VERIFIED and posts exactly one reversal (net receivable 0, outstanding 0); the idempotent replay returns the same result; another VERIFY is 409; a further refund is 409. A rejected refund frees the amount for a new request. Actions audited. Mutation counting only verified refunds failed.

Two concurrent batches selecting the same entry: one 200, one 409. Cancelling the draft releases the entry; a new batch with both entries totals 4800; selecting a settled entry again is 409; the creator cannot review (403); after review, line update and delete are refused by the database and CANCEL is 409; payment without reference 422; the recorder cannot reconcile (403); reconciliation by another person makes the statement show 4800 settled, 0 outstanding and no unsettled entries; refund staff cannot create batches (403). Mutation weakening line uniqueness failed.

Acceptance: duplicate refund and settlement prevented (TC-035/TC-036 above), over-refund rejected, cook-collected cash is not platform revenue (TC-034). Operations web finance section: component test sends refund payment with the current version and evidence reference and creates a settlement from selected unsettled entries for the statement period. Browser workflow regression passes; finance UI itself is not in the browser workflow (NOT_RUN).

findings: Over-refund and settlement uniqueness rules mutation-tested; concurrency covered.
